## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rename leaves the Commands section of `AGENTS.md` telling contributors to run `make test`, a target that no longer exists. This should be fixed because the guide states the repository has no CI, so that command is the only test check a change gets.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to match. It also adds a Layout section to `AGENTS.md` that lists each file and the Makefile targets.

(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the `make test` instruction in AGENTS.md to `make check` — Running `make test`, as the unchanged `AGENTS.md:24` instructs ("Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite."), now fails because this line renames the target to `check`. The added `AGENTS.md:15` says "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets", so the guide contradicts itself. — Contributors and agents following the guide get a make error instead of a test run, in a repository the guide says has no CI. — Fix: Change `AGENTS.md:24` to name `make check`.
